claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + magic_item mechanics family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no 'magic_item' kind. The v4 taxonomy has magic_item_root as a source atom but types.ts defines no MagicItemRecord, no MagicItemMechanics family, and no mechanics header for attuned wearable items. Every magic item in the survey will hit this gap first.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Wondrous Item, Rare (Requires Attunement) — a top-level record shape is needed before any magic-item mechanic can be expressed.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_ability_score
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The amulet's core mechanic is 'Your Constitution is 19 while you wear this amulet' — a floor-set override on an ability score. v4 TAXONOMY section 12 explicitly lists this as out-of-scope ('modify_ability_score as a runtime effect versus as pre-runtime character state'). It needs promotion to a first-class effect atom before this item can be encoded.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Your Constitution is 19 while you wear this amulet. It has no effect on you if your Constitution is 19 or higher without it.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: attunement mechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Requires Attunement means the item's effect is gated behind an attune procedure consuming an attunement_slot. The v4 taxonomy has 'attune' (procedure) and 'attunement_slot' (resource) atoms but they are not surfaced in any mechanics type. Magic items that require attunement need an attunement header analogous to spell-slot consumption.
